review.requested_change: Deeper and wider takeoff and landing arcs at the existing phase beats, rather than a taller short spike; preserve quiet air, split and neutral endpoints
review.changes: Add broad compression shoulders with monotone Hermite interpolation around unchanged main peaks; increase bounded downward displacement/pitch; preserve existing rebound, lateral/roll, phase duration and quiet air

changes.note: Broad shoulders retain compression into recovery instead of a narrow impulse. Main peak/rebound/end frames remain unchanged. Monotone interpolation carries velocity through shoulders; only extrema/ends stop. Added landing pitch and reduced backward translation preserve receiver framing while deepening the forward-muzzle arc. Original choreography, no reference-match claim.
